"...object detection (58.7 box AP and 51.1 mask AP on COCO test-dev)..."; matches Table 2(c) row 'Swin-L (HTC++)*', test-dev AP-mask column.
Regular ImageNet-1K trained models sub-table; row 'Swin-T', column '#param.' = 29M.

Row 'Swin-T', column 'ImageNet top-1 acc.' (two-line header) = 81.3, printed without a '%' glyph in the cell (table convention); restated with '%' in Section 4.1 prose (frame location 'Results with regular ImageNet-1K training').

ImageNet-22K pre-trained models sub-table; the second of two rows both printed 'Swin-B' (disambiguated by the 'image size' column: 224² above, 384² here). Table caption: "Throughput is measured using the GitHub repository of [68] and a V100 GPU, following [63]" -- own for every row of Table 1, this one included.

"Swin-B obtains 86.4% top-1 accuracy, which is 2.4% higher than that of ViT with similar inference throughput (84.7 vs. 85.9 images/sec) and slightly lower FLOPs (47.0G vs. 55.4G)." This label is the 84.7 (Swin-B, 384² input) half, restating Table 1(b); the 85.9 (ViT-B/16, also own per the Table 1 caption) is a separate frame cell not drawn here.

Table 2(b) 'Various backbones w. Cascade Mask R-CNN'; row 'X101-64' (ResNeXt101-64x4d). No citation bracket on this row (contrast Table 2(c), which brackets every citation baseline it lists). Section 4.2 prose: the comparisons in Table 2(a)/(b) are 'conducted by changing only the backbones with other settings unchanged' -- the authors ran every backbone, Swin and non-Swin alike, themselves within the same Cascade Mask R-CNN pipeline (DeiT-S†'s row is own for the same reason: 'we follow [81] to construct hierarchical feature maps for DeiT using deconvolution layers'). Treated as an own rerun of prior work (role result, is_own_result true), not a citation; confirmed against the page-7 render (no bracket on any Table 2(a)/(b) row).

"Our best model achieves 58.7 box AP and 51.1 mask AP on COCO test-dev, surpassing the previous best results by +2.7 box AP (Copy-paste [26] without external data) and +2.6 mask AP (DetectoRS [46])." Third printed occurrence of this value (abstract, introduction, here); matches Table 2(c) row 'Swin-L (HTC++)*'. The +2.7 delta is not a separate cell: the absolute value is printed beside it in the same sentence.

System-level Comparison table; row 'Swin-L (HTC++)' (mini-val APbox 57.1, APmask 49.5; test-dev APbox 57.7, APmask 50.2; #param 284M; this label is the FLOPs cell, 1470G). No citation bracket -- contrast RepPointsV2*[12], GCNet*[7] etc. above it. HTC++ is the authors' own improved detection framework (Section 4.2), so this row is an own system-level result; distinguished from the following 'Swin-L (HTC++)*' row (asterisk = multi-scale testing, no FLOPs printed there).

Table 3 row Method='UperNet', Backbone='Swin-S'. No citation bracket on this row (contrast e.g. 'OCRNet[73] HRNet-w48' above it); own ADE20K semantic-segmentation run, the same own-rerun pattern as Table 2 (Swin/DeiT-S† backbones plugged into a shared framework, confirmed against the page-7 render).
Row Method='UperNet', Backbone='Swin-B‡'. ‡ indicates the model is pre-trained on ImageNet-22K (Table 3 caption). No citation bracket; own result, same reasoning as L10.

Ablation of position-embedding methods; row 'abs. pos.' (absolute position embedding term of ViT, substituted for the default relative position bias), column 'top-1' under the 'ImageNet' group header (alongside 'top-5'). Table caption: ablation uses the Swin-T architecture throughout.

Row 'Performer [14]', column 'S2' under the group header 'MSA in a stage (ms)' (S1-S4 correspond to the architecture's four stages, Section 3.1). Table caption: 'Real speed of different self-attention computation methods and implementations on a V100 GPU' -- a uniform benchmark run by the authors across every listed method (own result); the [14] citation attributes only the Performer method/architecture, not this specific timing figure. Not tied to a named dataset/split.

Row 'window (w/o shifting)' (regular, non-shifted window attention -- the ablation counterpart to the paper's shifted-window design), column 'T' under the group header 'Arch. (FPS)' (whole-architecture throughput for the Swin-T-sized variant, as opposed to the per-stage MSA-only timing in columns S1-S4). Same own-benchmark reasoning as L13.

Row 'Swin-Mixer-T/D12' (D = number of channels per head, per caption), column 'ImageNet top-1 acc.' = 79.6. Own Swin-Mixer variant (hierarchical design and shifted-window attention applied to the MLP-Mixer architecture, Appendix A3.3), distinct from the cited MLP-Mixer/ResMLP baseline rows above it in the same table.
